ic_name: MIPI D-PHY / CSI-2 (TI SLLA414 application note)

spec_provided_observability.name: Eye diagram (HS pair)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Verify HS driver / receiver / channel quality at multi-gigabit; jitter, opening, common-mode.

spec_provided_observability.name: Sync pattern integrity
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Confirm receiver locks on 8'b00011101 (LSB-first 10111000); miss-lock indicates clock-recovery or skew issue.

spec_provided_observability.name: ECC parity coverage
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Header ECC = extended Hamming(8,4); single-bit-correct & double-bit-detect over DI + WC.

spec_provided_observability.name: CRC-16 verification
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Long-Packet payload integrity; polynomial 0x1021 init 0xFFFF; mismatch reported but not retransmitted.

spec_provided_observability.name: Lane skew / deskew
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Inter-pair skew across N Data Lanes must be ≤ 100 ps; intra-pair skew Dp/Dn ≤ 5 ps; trained at HS Entry.

spec_provided_observability.name: LP/HS mode transition timing
spec_provided_observability.purpose: T-LPX, T-HS-PREPARE, T-HS-ZERO, T-HS-TRAIL, T-EOT must all meet D-PHY v1.x bounds.

spec_provided_observability.name: LP-Contention detection
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reported by lane-state controller when both ends drive conflicting LP states.

spec_provided_observability.name: Frame / line counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: FS / FE short packets carry frame number; receiver counts FS/FE matches to verify completeness.

spec_provided_observability.name: Virtual Channel decode
spec_provided_observability.purpose: DI[7:6] (or DI[7:6]+extension in v1.2+) identifies VC; receiver routes to correct decoder.

error_detection_mechanisms: Header ECC (Hamming 8,4) single-bit-correct / double-bit-detect on every packet header.
Payload CRC-16 (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, MSB-first) on every Long-Packet payload.
Sync-pattern miss-lock — receiver fails to find 8'b00011101 within HS-Zero window; entire burst lost.
T-HS-* timing violation — per-lane bit errors; usually surface as ECC / CRC failures.
Lane-skew exceeded — multi-lane payload de-interleave misalignment; ECC / CRC failures.
LP-Contention — both endpoints assert mutually exclusive LP states.
False EoT (End-of-Transmission) — HS-Trail violated or missing LP-11 return.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Short Packet DT=0x00 received with valid ECC.
Short Packet DT=0x01 received with valid ECC.
1-bit error in header ECC was corrected.
2-bit error in header ECC was detected; packet dropped.
Receiver did not find Sync within HS-Zero window.
Source / sink escape commands; bus enters / exits Ultra-Low Power State.

notes: CSI-2 specifies a rich set of in-band error-detection mechanisms (ECC, CRC) but provides NO retransmission — host application + ISP decide whether to drop / interpolate / log a corrupted line. Production-line characterization relies on eye-diagram measurements on the HS pair and on running the receiver through stress patterns (lane skew, jitter, voltage margin) per MIPI D-PHY conformance test suite.
